title: Mega Menu
purpose: Expose a large set of site-navigation destinations in scanable groups when a simple dropdown would not provide enough hierarchy or overview.

composition.role: navigates to a category landing page when such a destination exists
shows and hides one mega panel
composition.semantics: button with aria-expanded and optional aria-controls

composition.role: optional secondary teaser that supports navigation

trigger.baseline: click/tap and Enter/Space on native button
trigger.link_separation: If the top-level category navigates, keep its link separate from the disclosure button.

open_panels.new_trigger: opening another panel closes the previous panel

dismiss.escape: close the open panel and return focus to its disclosure trigger
dismiss.pointer_outside: may close when explicitly implemented; must not be the only dismiss path

keyboard.tab: normal document tab order through top-level controls and visible panel links
keyboard.arrow_keys: optional enhancement only; never replace Tab/Shift+Tab unless the complete alternate keyboard contract is intentionally implemented

if_enabled: the pointer can move from trigger into panel without closing it
avoid immediate flicker; 300–500 ms is an evidence-based starting range, not a mandatory constant
meet WCAG 1.4.13 dismissible, hoverable and persistent requirements

behavior.current_page: Use aria-current on the destination link, not on the disclosure trigger.

layout.desktop: two-dimensional panel with clearly separated groups
layout.grouping: group related links into manageable chunks; do not create an undifferentiated link wall
layout.featured_content: at most subordinate to the navigation groups; do not turn the panel into a mini application

visual.preserve: clear distinction between top-level navigation, disclosure state, group labels and links

responsive.strategy: preserve information architecture while changing presentation
responsive.narrow_viewport: stack groups/disclosures vertically instead of squeezing desktop columns

performance.panel_content: navigation content should be lightweight and immediately available
performance.featured_media: optional teaser media should not block navigation usability

constraints: Do not use role=menu, role=menubar or role=menuitem merely because the component is called a Mega Menu.
Do not combine navigation and disclosure into one ambiguous control when the top-level category itself is a destination.
Do not require hover to reveal navigation.
Do not add instant hover switching that causes accidental flicker.
Do not replace normal Tab navigation with custom arrow-key behavior by default.
Do not mark a disclosure trigger as aria-current=page.
Do not overload the panel with forms, carousels, tabs or other complex application widgets.
Do not change the information architecture between desktop and mobile unless explicitly required.

agent_contract.instruction: Reconstruct from this Build DNA rather than copying reference HTML. Preserve navigation semantics and information hierarchy. Ask for missing IA, hover and dismiss decisions instead of inventing them.
agent_contract.when_conflicting: Purpose, constraints, behavior and accessibility override visual resemblance.
agent_contract.output_expectation: Production-appropriate Mega Menu code for the requested stack plus explicitly listed unresolved IA or interaction decisions.

request_examples.prompt: Baue mir ein Mega Menu nach https://blame76.github.io/how-to-web/elements/navigation/mega-menu/ und nutze die Build DNA als Rekonstruktionsvertrag. Behandle Website-Navigation nicht als ARIA-Menubar.
Baue mir die Variante "Grouped Links". Erhalte Linkhierarchie, Disclosure-Zustand, Escape und die mobile Informationsarchitektur.
Baue mir die Variante "Task Based". Gruppiere Ziele nach Nutzeraufgaben statt internen Abteilungen.
Baue mir die Variante "Featured Content". Ein visueller Teaser darf Navigation unterstützen, aber Links und Gruppen nicht verdrängen.

request_examples.intent: Adapt the Mega Menu contract to an existing navigation.
request_examples.prompt: Übertrage das how-to-web Mega Menu in mein bestehendes Projekt. Nutze vorhandene Navigation und Tokens und erfinde keine Hover-, Dismiss- oder IA-Regeln.

acceptance: Typical site navigation uses navigation/link/disclosure semantics rather than ARIA menu or menubar roles.
Every panel can be opened by click/tap and keyboard without hover.
Escape closes the open panel and returns focus to its trigger.
Moving focus fully outside the navigation closes the open panel.
Normal Tab and Shift+Tab navigation remains available.
At most one mega panel is open at a time in the documented variants.
Current-page state is applied to the destination link, not the trigger.
Grouped links remain scanable and semantically structured.
Mobile preserves the same information architecture.
The navigation remains usable at 320 CSS px and 200% zoom.

examples.note: Classic category grouping with hybrid top-level link plus disclosure button.
Navigation groups organized around user tasks.
Grouped navigation plus one subordinate visual teaser.
